§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 food and beverage vocabulary to advanced C1 strategy and sustainability discourse, every module is anchored in real-world dining scenarios — from kitchen operations to menu development, from food safety to restaurant crises. Built for use inside restaurants, hospitality groups, food suppliers, and culinary schools.

01

Industry-anchored

Every question reflects real terminology from kitchen operations, front-of-house service, and supply chain sourcing in 2026.

AI & smart kitchens

GenAI menu planning, smart kitchen systems, and predictive demand forecasting run throughout the program — reflecting today's food and beverage industry.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. Foodie reflects his vision: language learning as strategic capability — a multiplier of careers, kitchens, and hospitality.

Designed for the chefs, restaurateurs, and hospitality leaders shaping global dining — Foodie is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to lead in one of the world's most hands-on, fast-paced industries.
